user.title: Casa Mia Camera Commander
user.description: Add the camera commanders from the Casa Mia app: a device for each, with its Main camera and Track motion, and the pictures through Home Assistant for the Camera Commander card. Uses the Casa Mia integration's connection to the app.

abort.already_configured: Casa Mia Camera Commander is already set up.

abort.no_casa_mia: Set up the Casa Mia integration first.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating Casa Mia Camera Commander

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Casa Mia Camera Commander integration was updated from {from_version} to {to_version}, but Home Assistant is still running {from_version}. Until it restarts, nothing new in {to_version} works: new devices and entities (such as a commander's Main camera, which its card's taps use) do not exist yet. Restart Home Assistant to load it.
